frontends.name: studio
frontends.buildSpec:
version: 1
frontend:
  phases:
    preBuild:
      commands:
        - npm ci
    build:
      commands:
        - npm run build
  artifacts:
    baseDirectory: dist
    files:
      - '**/*'
  cache:
    paths:
      - node_modules/**/*

frontends.name: pwa
frontends.buildSpec:
version: 1
frontend:
  phases:

frontends.name: site
frontends.buildSpec:
version: 1
frontend:
  phases:
    preBuild:
      commands:
        - npm ci --cache .npm --prefer-offline
    build:
      commands:
        - npm run build
  artifacts:
    baseDirectory: dist
    files:
      - '**/*'
  cache:
    paths:
      - .npm/**/*

limitations: Backend source HEAD does not attest deployed function source; per-function CodeSha256 is the baseline.
No database schema inventory or migration application in this stage.
Both dev and prod backend stages serve production.
